Chapter 1095: 23 Strength Transformation (Requesting Subscriptions)_2

Chapter 1095: Chapter 23 Strength Transformation (Requesting Subscriptions)_2

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

According to his estimation, his internal universe, at the limit of the master realm, will reach a range of hundreds of billions of light years.

“The internal universe of a normal Chaos Venerable is within a range of hundreds of billions of light years in diameter. If I grow to the extreme in the master realm, I can match the internal universe of a Chaos Venerable in size…”

Lin Yuan pondered.

This is comparing the size of the internal universe. In fact, Lin Yuan’s internal universe, after being perfected by the “Infinite Void,” when it was merely a domain of tens of millions of light years, was already comparable to the internal universe of a Chaos Venerable spanning hundreds of billions of light years.

When Lin Yuan’s internal universe expands to a range of hundreds of billions of light years, ordinary Chaos Venerables, even if their life level is higher than Lin Yuan’s, would be swept away by the terrifying foundation of his internal universe, beneath the Chaos Great Saint.

The strength of the internal universe is not just determined by size. Diamond and carbon have the same constituent particles, but their hardness is vastly different.

“If I step into the Chaos Realm, won’t my internal universe reach a diameter of trillions, tens of trillions, or even hundreds of trillions of light years?”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts spread out. It is known that a naturally born universe in the normal Chaos Void is about a trillion light years in diameter.

And as long as Lin Yuan crosses into the Chaos Realm, will his internal universe surpass the naturally born universe in size?

“So strong.”

Lin Yuan couldn’t help but exclaim, at the same time thinking of the “Infinite Void” inheritance.

Up to now, the internal universe of Lin Yuan has reached such heights, driven by many factors, such as three times the Chaos Void Origin Infusion, suppression by the Chaos Tree, and so on.

But the main reason is still this thirteenth-order inheritance from the jade gourd.

To be precise, it is the inheritance created by the thirteenth-order time life from its foundation, specifically to enhance the foundation of living beings.

“The creator of the jade gourd, that thirteenth-order time life, left behind inheritances not only targeting the foundation with ‘Infinite Void’ but also body, soul, mind, and will…”

Lin Yuan recalled the words of the red-clad girl, his expression inevitably poignant.

Just the ‘Infinite Void’ aiming at the foundation has elevated him so much. If he were to cultivate all the inheritances left by that thirteenth-order time-life, what kind of freak would it create?

“Being able to acquire ‘Infinite Void’ is already lucky enough. Wanting other thirteenth-order inheritances would be a bit greedy.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

Can’t let all the good things fall to him?

“But my current strength…”

Lin Yuan began to evaluate himself, initially entering the master realm level, with life’s essence elevated and transformed, and the internal universe’s physical body and soul all skyrocketed.

This made Lin Yuan’s strength nearly reach the pinnacle level of the Chaos Realm.

“I wonder if, after reaching the extreme in the master realm, I can be invincible among Venerables and be comparable to that Chaos Great Saint?”

Lin Yuan pondered.

Though Venerables and Great Saints both belong to the Chaos Realm, there is a vast difference in combat power.

The battle between the Shadow Demon Great Saint and the Nine Phoenix Great Saint, even just the aftermath, led the Ancient Ming Venerable to decide to relocate the Chaos Continent.

From this, one can glean a thing or two.

However, Lin Yuan’s foundation is here. If he could truly grow to the limit of the master realm, cultivate many means to the extremity, “Infinite Void” second layer, or even the third layer?

Even if it still cannot directly contend with a Great Saint, the gap would not be too large.

“Time to leave.”

Lin Yuan’s figure swiftly shrank, then glanced around.

During his breakthrough, the absorbing of chaotic qi from all directions caused quite a stir, having already caught the attention of some Chaos Venerables.

These Chaos Venerables were unsure of what kind of strong presence Lin Yuan was, so they did not immediately probe but hovered from a great distance.

Swoosh.

Lin Yuan’s figure disappeared directly, having no intention of contacting other Chaos Venerables.

….

“Left?”

“Who was it after all?”

“A spectacle of life? Or a certain pinnacle of the Chaos Realm?”

One by one, the wills of the Chaos Venerables reached out, exchanging with each other. The scene of massively absorbing chaotic qi just now had shocked the Venerables of several Void Domains around.

Even though they couldn’t sense the aura the other party exuded, just the movement of chaotic qi around made many Venerables shudder.

“Seems he doesn’t wish to meet us.”

“Forget it, let’s all go back.”

Many Chaos Venerables were somewhat regretful. Being able to cultivate to a Chaos Venerable, naturally, they have long passed the stage of fighting and killing.

For a Chaos Venerable, making acquaintance with a powerful Venerable is definitely beneficial without any harm. The existence that just absorbed vast chaotic qi clearly fell under the category of a powerful Venerable.

“Why do I feel somewhat familiar?”

The Ancient Ming Venerable also sent out a projection of consciousness. Although the existence that engulfed endless chaotic qi did not leak the slightest aura, even the cause and effect were concealed.

Still, the Ancient Ming Venerable vaguely felt familiar.

…

Star Tear’s ‘Fragment World.’

The Xuanyuan Supreme, Xia Qin Supreme, and several other supremes wore grave expressions.

Just now, while they were having a good conversation with the Galaxy Supreme, Lin Yuan’s avatar dissipated directly, leaving only the words ‘have urgent matters to attend to.’

This made the supremes a bit worried.

Urgent matters?

What urgent matters could human civilization have nowadays?

At this moment.

Star Tear’s ‘Fragment World’ trembled slightly, and Lin Yuan’s figure appeared before Xia Qin Supreme and the others.

“Galaxy, are you okay?”

The Xuanyuan Supreme immediately asked with concern.
